title.zh: 社区合唱团排练协调员

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Coordinate rehearsal rooms and musician availability; volunteer organizing experience is welcome.
requirements.zh: 协调排练室及音乐人员可用时间；欢迎志愿组织经历。

requirements.en: Maintain attendance, approved score distribution and clear rehearsal communications.
requirements.zh: 维护出席记录、获批乐谱分发及清晰排练沟通。

requirements.en: Operate a live sound-mixing desk for amplified rehearsals.
requirements.zh: 在扩声排练中操作现场调音台。
